control_flow: avoidWalls: if LLIGHT is below 30 %, check the left and right obstacle sensors and curve away, else call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, drive straight forward at 30 %, else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop, else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left, else curve right.
There is no wait and no variable: the loop runs thousands of times a second.
